description:
Update an existing numbering series in Holded.

Args:
  - doc_type (string): Document type (required)
  - numbering_series_id (string): The numbering series ID to update (required)
  - name (string): Series name
  - format (string): Format string for document numbers
  - last (string): Last number used in the series (string format)

Returns:
  The updated numbering series.

doc_type.description: Document type: invoice, salesreceipt, creditnote, receiptnote, estimate, salesorder, waybill, proform, purchase, purchaserefund, purchaseorder

last.description: Last number used in the series (string format)

numbering_series_id.description: The numbering series ID to update

name: holded_invoicing_update_numbering_serie
title: Update Holded Numbering Series
